'''Energy blade''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell was only known by [[Yapi]] [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]], and they rarely shared the technique with outsiders unless they demonstrated a great feat of bravery, or promised a gain of some kind.

The spell was applied to a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] to increase the damage it could inflict. The weapon glowed brightly and acted much like a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The affected weapon could parry lightsabers, and when used in conjunction with [[battle mastery]], could be used to parry [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.
